name: @lambda-factori/mobile-capacitor
description: Experiment: the web build packaged as a native iOS app with Capacitor.

scripts.sync: pnpm --filter @lambda-factori/web build && node scripts/start-page.ts && cap sync ios
scripts.build:sim: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
